profile.headline: Software Engineer @DigitalFish on assignment at Meta Platforms, Inc.
profile.summary: Highly reliable and versatile software engineer with a strong sense of ownership and a data-centric approach to problem-solving. A fast learner focused on delivering high-quality products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Onsite @Meta - Reality Lab (XR AI Sensing - Camera & Sensors) · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Led large-scale data discovery and ingestion for XR AI Sensing, managing unstructured data (video, photo) and metadata from internal and external sources.
- Coordinated external vendor relationships for data collection and annotation, ranging from designing capture specifications, managing and customizing annotation tooling, ensuring stringent data quality and privacy compliance.
- Defined data scenarios and KPIs to evaluate feature readiness, covering deep-dive ad-hoc analysis of dogfooding survey data, A/B testing and subjective studies to inform shipping decisions.
- Supported the development of comprehensive telemetry for XR/AR camera features, tracking key metrics (such as reliability, latency, quality of capture, import and data processing).
- Experienced in large-scale ML model training and inference, batch processing, and efficient result aggregation. Expertise includes model serving, optimizing GPU utilization, and inference optimization in computer vision infrastructure, along with sophisticated classifier evaluation, including precision/recall trade-offs, threshold tuning, and false positive analysis in ML detection workflows.
- Served on-call for Data Infrastructure teams, ensuring production monitoring, swift incident response, and SLA-driven operations.
- Consistently leverage AI-agent tools to enhance daily workflows, aligning with Meta’s new standard for productivity.

positions.title: Data Engineer, Camera & Depth - Signal Processing Team | Magnit @ Meta
positions.description:
- Developed software that applies cutting-edge research in Multimodal Generative AI to automatically generate precise annotations for videos and images, significantly reducing the need for manual annotation labor. 
- Performed end-to-end data processing from data discovery, annotation, and cleaning to data model selection, validation, deployment, and data governance ensuring data readiness for model training on the cloud. 
- Designed, built and maintained several data pipelines for the team.
- Worked with multiple teams in integrating, structuring, analyzing, and managing large amounts of data from diverse sources in the order of terabytes.
- Conducted quantitative analysis to evaluate model’s performance and improve data quality in terms of relevancy, completeness, and variety.
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · Machine Learning · Computer Vision · Software Development · Cloud Storage · ETL Tools · Project Management · Jupyter notebook · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Algorithms

positions.title: Data Analyst/Scientist
positions.description:
- Built a variety of Machine Learning/Deep Learning models, applying computer vision for different projects in life sciences, healthcare and education.
- Obtained positive feedbacks and 50,000+ views for some technical blog posts published on Towards Data Science (a Medium publication), in which I helped beginners to tackle some issues when using AWS Command Line Interface (CLI), designing and building cloud-based data models on AWS.
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · Computer Vision · Project Management · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Algorithms

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description:
- Led the Department of Molecular and Environmental Biotechnology (20+ staffs) to collect, analyze data, and write up the program self-report; succeeded in obtaining the quality assurance certificate from the ASEAN University Network-Quality Assurance for the Biotechnology master program within a year (the standard process normally takes 2-3 years to complete).
- Designed and taught the course “Computer-Based Practice on Bioinformatics” (150+ students each semester).

positions.title: Assistant Product Manager
positions.description:
- Strategically planned to penetrate new markets for launching new mobile apps. 
- Worked closely with engineering and design team to improve UI/UX to acquire and retain users. 
- Led the efforts of applying content marketing to attract new users using micro-influencers via various social media networks.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Ph.D. Thesis - Phosphoproteomics and Transcriptomic Profiling of Soybean-Bradyrhizobium Symbiosis in Root Hairs
       + Identifying the soybean phosphoproteins significant regulated in response to Bradyrhizobium japonicum.
       + Developing the synthetic peptide cocktail for screening the kinase clients using the solution-phase, label-free peptide kinase assay coupled to LC-MS/MS analysis.
       + Characterizing genes involving in nodule development through RNAi gene silencing approach.

- Other projects:
       + Transcriptomic/proteomic analysis of soybean root hair in response to abiotic stress. 
       + Transcriptomic/proteomic analysis of soybean seeds at different stages of development. 
       + Transcriptomic/proteomic analysis of soybean leaves infected by aphids using sensitive and resistant lines. 
       + Characterizing genes involving in nodulation (soybean ecto-apyrase), plant defense responses (LysM Receptor-like Kinase LysM RLK4 (LYK4)).

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Protein secondary and tertiary structure prediction - protein structure exploratory analysis and feature engineering.

positions.title: Teaching and Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Research Assistant: Developing ELISA kit to detect Salmonella in food products.
- Teaching Assistant: Labwork on Microbiology I, Microbiology II, and Gene Manipulation.

publications.title: Identification of soybean proteins and genes differentially regulated in near isogenic lines differing in resistance to aphid infestation.
Identification of soybean proteins from a single cell type: the root hair.
